verdicts.reason: Both show a visible lighter overlay panel ending abruptly at x≈125 and x≈640, leaving hard vertical seams across the background, and both keep the title lockup small in a big, mostly empty canvas. A also breaks up the lockup: its two stars are thrown to the far edges, away from the tagline, the rule and title hang left while the tagline sits off to the right, and the palm icon floats off-axis. B keeps the logo, rule, title, dotted divider and starred tagline together in one tight group, though the right star touches 'Have' and the group sits a little off-center.
